# Operator Note — Line startup: Machining line (see SOP-P2-L3-01)

Purpose
- Provide a quick reference for safe, consistent startup of the machining line in support of SOP-P2-L3-01.

Pre-start checks
- Verify area is clear of nonessential personnel and loose items.
- Confirm required PPE is in place and condition is acceptable.
- Ensure tooling, fixtures, and workholding are correctly installed and secured.
- Confirm coolant, lubrication, and compressed air systems are online and within normal operating parameters.
- Check control panels for any active fault indicators and ensure all guards and interlocks are engaged.

Startup sequence
- Establish communication with downstream and upstream stations; announce startup intent.
- Energize primary systems and allow controls to reach stable state before loading parts.
- Run an unloaded spindle and feed verify to confirm smooth motion and absence of unusual noises or vibration.
- Perform a single slow-speed dry cycle if appropriate to validate axis motion and tool alignment.
- Load a calibrated verification blank and complete first-article machining; inspect critical features per SOP before proceeding to production flow.

If abnormalities occur
- Stop the line immediately on any abnormal noise, vibration, smoke, or unexpected excursions.
- Tag out and notify maintenance with a concise incident description.
- Do not resume production until root cause is identified and corrective action is documented.

Documentation
- Record startup events, first-article inspection results, and any issues in the shift log per SOP requirements.
